chunks: And ʿAlī ibn al-Rayyān ibn al-Ṣalt asked Abū al-Ḥasan al-Thālith عليه السلام:
About a man who takes from his hair and his nails, then rises for salat (prayer) without shaking it off from his garment; so he said: “There is no issue.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm or problem

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to pray if trimmed hair or nail remnants remain on one’s clothes?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that if a person trims his hair or nails and then performs salat (prayer) without removing the remnants from his clothing, there is no problem. It indicates the permissibility of praying in such a state and that such remnants do not invalidate the prayer.
